notes.gemm_and_moe: Quant modes here are used by SDK ops for weight memory scaling, compute throughput assumptions, and perf-table lookup axes.
notes.kvcache: KV cache quant mode models stored/read KV cache precision; live q/k/v activations can remain BF16 unless a collector/backend explicitly casts them.
notes.fmha: FMHA quant mode models attention compute/table axis. For DeepSeek V3 SGLang defaults in this run it is BF16 even when KV cache is FP8.
